comment: Versions the kona parity gate runs against. run.sh reads kona_host.image and anvil.*; the CI jobs read op_stack_e2e_tests.commit from the workflow checkout step, which must equal the value here.

kona_client.note: kona-host --native runs the kona-client program in-process (bin/host/src/single/cfg.rs:208-222), so the gate executes kona-client from the kona-host image; the kona-client image is the cannon build and is pinned for ticket 14.

op_node.note: Built from the OP monorepo commit the harness pins; op-batcher and op-deployer come from the same commit.

op_reth.note: Acceptance oracle of ADR 0001. Not started by this gate; recorded so a mismatch can be re-run against op-reth with the same pins.

anvil.note: kona-host reads L1 through debug_getRawHeader and debug_getRawReceipts (bin/host/src/single/handler.rs:82,109). anvil serves them from foundry v1.8.0 (crates/anvil/core/src/eth/mod.rs:369,377); v1.2.3 and v1.7.1 do not register them.

genesis_hash.note: Placeholder. The harness writes the L1 head timestamp into the L2 genesis header on every run (setup_c2.sh step 3, header_override.json), so the hash changes per run and cannot be pinned until ticket 12 makes genesis reproducible. run.sh prints the observed hash.
